patch.value: Make the 2026.10.23 pm toolchain bump pass: the recipes test host double dropped the SDK's generic ReadPromise get signature

value.author: codex
value.text:
Cause: pm-cli 2026.10.23 changed PmClient.get to a generic ReadPromise<GetResult, Options> signature (read-output contracts), so the recipes test hand-rolled peer-transition double (async get(id) returning Promise<GetResult>) no longer satisfied FailureFirstHost and the test build failed with TS2345 at test/recipes.test.ts(132,49).
Fix: keep the double delegating to the real SDK client but make its get wrapper a faithful generic passthrough (Options extends GetOptions & PmReadOutputOptions, forwarding id and options to reader.get); no casts, no widened double, no loosened assertions. CHANGELOG.md regenerated with the bumped pm-changelog, which now emits a Closed section for closed tracker items.
Evidence: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json exits 0; node --test --test-concurrency=2 test/recipes.test.ts 6/6 pass; npm run release:check green locally (coverage-gate thresholds met, changelog up to date, attestation ok).
